{{Otheruses|New Plympto resistance}}
The '''second New Plympto resistance''' was the [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] resistance against the forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] occupying [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]. The movement began in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="Gamer">{{GamerCite|9|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Nosaurians}}</ref> as the Nosaurians rebelled against Imperial [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]],<ref name="CSWE II 391">{{CSWECite|II|391}}</ref> the razing of cities,<ref name="Gamer" /> and the seizure of assets on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="C&TCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>

[[General/Legends|General]] [[Fefar Blackeye]] rose up as the resistance's spiritual and martial leader,<ref name="C&TCW" /> and his forces harassed Imperial targets in a two-year campaign of guerrilla strikes. Nevertheless, at some point in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Blackeye found himself surrounded by Imperial forces. They waited him out, and at sundown, he was overcome by his species' innate urge to bray at the setting sun. This inopportune song told the Imperial forces where to find him, and Blackeye was captured.<ref name="Gamer" />

Blackeye was shipped out to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where he was put on display at a zoo, caged with a group of non-[[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Primate/Legends|primates]]. He killed himself after six months in such conditions. Meanwhile, back on New Plympto, the resistance fell apart without its leader.<ref name="Gamer" />
